source_alignment.note: Intent semantics, metrics, funnel stages, areas/categories, and answer boundaries are aligned to the current EyeMakkah BI prototype. This file does not modify or integrate the BI.

purpose: Bilingual analytical intent bank for Dashboard, Demand, Areas, Activities, Communities, and Engagement & Rewards. All analytical answers are dynamic and must be resolved from the active BI filters and current synthetic/demo data.

integration_contract.placeholder_rule: Never hardcode a current winner/value where the BI can change it from filters. Resolve {{placeholders}} from the existing BI calculation functions.
integration_contract.ranking_rule: Rank only the data represented in the current synthetic BI model.
integration_contract.comparison_rule: When comparing two entities, use the same active period/category/audience context for both unless the query explicitly changes it.
truthfulness: Treat all values as synthetic/illustrative prototype data.
Do not present demand/supply signals as guaranteed commercial opportunities.
Do not infer individuals, identities, psychological profiles, or personal data.
Do not generate pricing, revenue forecasts, ROI, break-even, or financial feasibility conclusions.
